d: Janjatiy gaurav divas ke avsar par pradhanmantri narendr modi ne deshbhar ko 246 vikas pariyojnaon ki saugat di. is dauran ranchi men eklavy modal aavasiy vidyalay ke bhavan ka shilanyas bhi kiya gaya. pradhanmantri ne vikas ki mukhyadhara se vanchit vargon ko jorne aur unhen prathmikta dene ke sankalp ko dohraya. vahin, dharti aaba bhagvan birsa munda ki jayanti par kritagy rashtr unhen naman kar raha hai. is avsar par jharkhand ke rajyapal santosh kumar gangvar aur mukhyamantri hemant soren ne bhi bhagvan birsa munda ko shraddhanjli arpit ki. rajy sthapna divas ke avsar par svachchhata…
